subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live Matrix verification proof, or may a maintainer explicitly override proof and accept the private matrix-js-sdk hook?
rationale: The code path is source-backed and narrowly tested, but the remaining merge gate is real Element/Synapse behavior plus a private dependency hook that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Require Live Matrix Proof First
options.body: Ask for redacted live logs, terminal output, linked artifact, or a recording from this branch showing the SAS flow complete after the accept event is normalized.

options.title: Override Proof And Own Hook
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the private `cryptoBackend.preprocessToDeviceMessages` wrapper and proof gap as sufficient for merge.

options.title: Pause For Upstream Direction
options.body: If the private hook is not acceptable, leave the PR open or close it in favor of an upstream matrix-js-sdk or Element compatibility fix.

recommendation.title: Require Live Matrix Proof First
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live logs, terminal output, linked artifact, or a recording from this branch showing the SAS flow complete after the accept event is normalized.
